schema_description.sources: 仓库标识到锁定提交、许可及只读核验状态；所有 path 都相对各仓库根目录。
schema_description.engines: id/document/module 标识条目；source_refs 是实际查阅的文件与符号；algorithms 说明可调用函数及输入输出。
schema_description.limitations: 每个条目明确不支持的方言、调用者必须补齐的证明及部署缺口。
schema_description.source_license_ids: 来源许可，不把 GPL 来源算法重新声明为 MIT；分发需保留原许可和修改说明。

runtime.disk_writer: none; public parent layer owns safe output and deployment manifests

msg_tool.redistribution_note: 本集合包含按此源码改写的 Python 算法；父 Skill 分发时须随附 GPL 许可原文、来源及修改说明，不能统一改标 MIT。

sextractor.use: dialect comparison only; no runtime import or manager/global reuse

garbro.license: MIT (per-file notices for referenced ArcFormats implementations)
garbro.use: ArcFormats/Artemis/ArcPFS.cs is adapted into python/archives/pfs.py (MIT, Copyright (C) 2016-2017 by morkt; see licenses/MIT-GARbro.txt). YPF, Will ARC/AR2 and Softpal PAC adaptations are recorded in common-archives-v1.json; remaining routes listed below are recognition evidence.

shared_source_references.use: range replacement and old/new offset mapping; changed interiors must not be treated as valid target mappings

algorithms.input: decoded KAG str and original span-index -> translated str
algorithms.output: typed original spans or syntax-preserving str
algorithms.specifics: script/macro blocks, #name, label titles and ns/nse role state

engines.name_policy: separate name spans; $-prefixed names retained as read-only name_variable
limitations: finite r/l/p/cm/ns/nse inline tags only
no SCN/TJS/SOC writer or ruby/attribute grammar
no encoding/BOM/archive/deployment decisions

source_refs.use: ASB/IET recognition comparison, not algorithm dependency

algorithms.input: ASB bytes or typed ordered Command/Label tree; (item,attribute) -> str
algorithms.output: tree, typed field references, or rebuilt ASB bytes
algorithms.specifics: 0/1 item types, UTF-8 length excluding NUL, line numbers, ordered attributes

engines.name_policy: name.0 distinct from print.data, ruby.text, choice and history; no lossy grouping
limitations: no AST/TXT/Lua parser or complete IET control-flow editor
no print/ruby range merging
field-level text edits, not arbitrary command mutation or deployment validation

source_refs.use: general Artemis TXT line/speaker comparison; the '#'-prefixed speaker rule is deliberately not reused
comment/label/line-tag/command grammar and tag.ini blacklist comparison
pf8 record layout and SHA-1 XOR confirmation
container record layout, name field and pf8 key range; shared with python/archives/pfs.py

algorithms.input: SCP text bytes plus optional tag.ini schema and speaker policy, or translation rows
algorithms.output: typed ordered records with locators or rebuilt original-encoded bytes
algorithms.specifics: blank-line message groups, structural quotes, three-tier speaker evidence, protected inline directives, BOM/CRLF preservation, re-parse verification; Script.patch reuses the parsing policy

algorithms.input: tag.ini bytes
algorithms.output: declared tag set and attribute order
algorithms.specifics: section names exclude commands such as [var name=...] from speaker detection

engines.name_policy: writable only for the command's own name attribute; a voice-attribute tag yields a context name from the tag; a bare unknown character tag keeps its slot, reports name_policy absent and clears the stale speaker instead of inheriting the previous character
limitations: SCP text only; ASB/.ast stay in engines/artemis.md
volume load order and the trailing index table semantics are static inference, not runtime-verified
no streaming writer, so volumes above the in-memory budget cannot be repacked
no font/encoding or game-startup validation

algorithms.input: Ver1 bytes, externally proven code_length, operand-offset -> str
algorithms.output: code base, all typed string references, or rebuilt deduplicated pool bytes
algorithms.specifics: BurikoCompiledScriptVer1.00 signature without extension requirement; code-relative string pointers

engines.name_policy: string-stack name/message/choice classification; empty/internal strings retained and not writable
limitations: caller proves complete code region; no arbitrary VM calls/branches/v0
reject unreferenced pool tails, gaps and interior string references
not a general BGI writer

algorithms.input: CatScene bytes, original record-index -> engine-native str
algorithms.output: bounded inflated Scene/all typed records or appended-and-repointed CST
algorithms.specifics: zlib wrapper, relative index/pool bases, 01/type/cstring records, inner/outer lengths

engines.name_policy: retain all 0x21/0x20 records and empties; do not merge away consecutive names/continuations
limitations: writer only permits 0x20 and 0x21
no 0x30 choice-command or continuation semantics
screen metadata preserved but not interpreted
no CSTL/INT keys or full deployment support

source_refs.use: comparison only; pattern matching is not treated as VM completeness

algorithms.input: proven whole zero-based v1 code region, field ordinal -> display str
algorithms.output: fields/jump operands/boundaries or relocated code bytes
algorithms.specifics: 14 i32/internal/message, 15 name, 0F choices with embedded 02/06 jumps; source control restoration

engines.name_policy: all names retained; $-prefixed variables read-only; internal voice/string arguments excluded
limitations: no WS2 v2/v3 or guessed eight-byte footer
known prefix/suffix controls only
not a complete WS2 file writer

algorithms.input: code bytes or structurally valid MJO V/X file
algorithms.output: XOR bytes or file with normalized signature/code
algorithms.specifics: CRC polynomial EDB88320 table as 1024 LE bytes; XOR code only

algorithms.input: text with [base/reading] and newlines or canonical fragment
algorithms.output: Majiro text/proc/ldstr/Ruby/ctrl bytecode fragment or str
algorithms.specifics: u16 length includes NUL; Ruby hash 3198FD01

engines.name_policy: retain supplied combined display text; do not infer/drop multiple speakers
limitations: fragments are not patchable whole MJO output
entry/function/relative branches and codeSize need separate complete relocation
no arbitrary call/select/ldstr semantics or tunnel encoding

algorithms.input: explicit count/index/absoluteOffset MAP bytes, original table row -> str
algorithms.output: all Entry rows or bytes with every pointer repaired
algorithms.specifics: aligned UTF-16LE terminators, non-contiguous original index, empties, out-of-order table, alias consistency

engines.name_policy: MAP contains no proven local name type; external names remain context only
limitations: not SExtractor four-section MAP or MES VM
unknown gap/trailer bytes retained but not scanned for hidden pointers
interior/suffix pointers rejected; explicit dialect selection required

algorithms.input: Sv20, TEXT.DAT, POINT.DAT bytes, proven operand-role list and operand -> str
algorithms.output: reversed labels, typed text records, or (new code,new text,unchanged point)
algorithms.specifics: POINT base 0C, text address+4, append metadata+cstring, patch literal SRC operands only

engines.name_policy: name/message/choice/context_name retained; context or $-variable names cannot be written
limitations: operands must come from independent complete disassembly
encrypted TEXT rejected instead of merely changing flag
no full VM/user-call analysis
SRC and TEXT require coordinated deployment

algorithms.input: YSTB bytes and independently known u32 key
algorithms.output: bytes with four sections XORed separately
algorithms.specifics: restart key phase at every section; validate instruction count and total lengths

algorithms.input: CP932-like text bytes or YSCM ysc.ybn bytes
algorithms.output: converted control bytes or ordered commands/attributes with metadata
algorithms.specifics: EF F0/F2/F3/F5 and SJIS trail protection; game-local command IDs

engines.name_policy: no fake name/message extraction; caller must retain all attribute identities and name contexts
limitations: no key guessing, YSCF writer, expression VM or full YBN attribute relocation
unknown EF codes rejected
ysc.ybn must match scenario version
no YPF writer

algorithms.input: decoded SC str, field ordinal -> str
algorithms.output: decoded text, preserved field ranges, or new SC str
algorithms.specifics: .message third arg name/fourth onward body; .select caption before colon; @prefix and empty args retained

engines.name_policy: preserve full-width name spaces and $ variables; choices remain separate
limitations: finite command grammar, no PAZ/PAK crypto or writer
no automatic name-space stripping/wrapping
unknown escapes and colon injection rejected

algorithms.input: decoded S script str, field ordinal -> display str
algorithms.output: typed ranges or delimiter-preserving str
algorithms.specifics: bracket names, id/name/body, ^select including empty arguments, [n] conversion

engines.name_policy: all names and empty choices retained; $ names read-only; no global speaker collapse
limitations: no PACK keys/writer or universal QLIE tag grammar
no encoding auto-detection or SJIS tunnel
non-newline control tags must remain unchanged

algorithms.input: XML str, optional language, record index -> name/message fields
algorithms.output: typed records or semantic XML str
algorithms.specifics: xscript/code/msg and select/menu; explicit localized attributes and writable-name evidence

engines.name_policy: existing msg name attribute writable; absent names and menu context cannot be invented
limitations: semantic XML normalization, not byte preservation on edits
no namespace dialect, CSX v1/v2 compiler or NOA writer
caller owns file encoding and XML declaration
32 MiB input character limit

algorithms.input: canonical ESCR1_00 bytes, optional multi-name contexts, index -> str
algorithms.output: opaque VM/raw strings, decoded messages, or rebuilt indexed pool bytes
algorithms.specifics: special !/?/A0..DE mapping respects multibyte trails; offsets relative to pool; <r> newline

engines.name_policy: external names tuple is retained and always context-only; no fake writable enum name
limitations: no VM/enum/CustomOps or game-specific code
no LZW/archive crypto
only canonical pool; all string count/index identities stay fixed
reverse compact kana encoding not implemented

algorithms.input: RLD with known keys or exact decrypted op region
algorithms.output: bounded XOR bytes or known op structures/fragments
algorithms.specifics: 0x10..floor(min(size,FFCF)/4)*4; 256-key cycling; low-nibble string count

algorithms.input: defChara op48 / dialogue op28 structures, optional name map, op-index changes
algorithms.output: ID/name map, context-preserving dialogue, or patched structures
algorithms.specifics: * + first integer indirect names; $noname$ sentinel; definitions field0/field3

engines.name_policy: resolved indirect names and IDs retained but not writable; direct names permitted; $ sentinels/variables protected
limitations: op21/191 recognized as opaque structures, not supported choice translations
unknown opcode refused
no whole RLD header/tail writer, key discovery or offset relocation
write_ops emits only a fragment

algorithms.input: proven HCB code region, absolute base, literal-instruction address -> str
algorithms.output: 0E literal bytes, instructions, or new code and boundary map
algorithms.specifics: u8 byte length includes NUL; repair all recognized 02/06/07 absolute targets

algorithms.input: proven subset code
algorithms.output: initstack function address -> every candidate name
algorithms.specifics: initstack(3|5,0) heuristic without last-name-only loss

engines.name_policy: retain all candidate names including question marks as read-only heuristic context
limitations: not full HCB writer; caller must update script_len and main pointer using returned map
no syscall/ThreadStart pointer discovery
over 254 encoded text bytes rejected, no cloned-call splitting
no full VM, tail/import-table or runtime validation
